# WMG Records

> WMG Records (Wareham Music Group) is an independent label curating artist worlds and story-led releases across soul, blues, country, crooner and cinematic music.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Label overview, featured artists and latest releases.
- [Artists](/artists): The WMG Records roster.
- [Releases](/releases): Catalogue of singles, EPs and albums.
- [Journal](/journal): Essays, interviews and label notes.
- [About](/about): About Wareham Music Group and the WMG Records label.
- [Contact](/contact): Demos, press, sync and general enquiries.
- [Newsletter](/newsletter): Join the list for new releases and first access.
- [Legal](/legal): Privacy, terms and legal information.
